up: Retrieve the chembl_id and pref_name of all molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5728039'. Filter the docs table where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728039'. Join with compound_records on doc_id, then join with molecule_dictionary on molregno. Return the molecule chembl_id and pref_name. Do not apply any additional filters, limits, or ranking.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728039'
